title: IKMS RAG Agent System — Backend
executive_summary: The IKMS RAG Agent System is a backend service that implements a multi-agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipeline for intelligent document question-answering, allowing users to upload PDF documents, ask natural language questions, and receive verified answers through a structured agentic process.

section_summaries.summary: The IKMS RAG Agent System is designed for intelligent document question-answering, enabling users to upload PDF documents for indexing and ask questions to receive grounded answers through a multi-stage agent pipeline.

The architecture consists of a FastAPI API that interacts with a LangGraph QA Graph, which includes planning, retrieval, summarization, and verification agents, culminating in a final verified answer.
The system utilizes a variety of technologies including Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, OpenAI, and Pinecone, with specific version requirements for each component.
The core components include the API layer, multi-agent pipeline, LangGraph orchestration, vector store and retrieval, LLM factory, and configuration management.

important_facts: The system processes PDFs entirely in-memory with no disk writes.
The multi-agent pipeline consists of four stages: Planning, Retrieval, Summarization, and Verification.
